svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print four in PETG lying on a side face, so the layers run along

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the clamp: 6 walls, 40 % infill, about 50 g each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Body 70 long, 24 wide, 30 deep. Slot 6.6 mm wide, 31.5 mm long,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its centre 7 mm from the middle toward the toe end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Heel at the other end, 14 mm long, as tall as the work (40 mm here).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: an M6 x 80 cap screw with a printed knob passes through the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: slot into a threaded hole; the toe presses the work, the heel

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stands on the table. Slide the body so the screw is nearer the toe.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark 1.6 N m MAX on the top: never tighten past it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no cracks or gaps between layers at the slot ends.
